name: privacy
title: 🔒 Privacy Policy
section1:
**What we collect**
• **AI configuration** (MongoDB) — enabled/disabled, auto-respond channels, mention mode, banned users
• **BlaBlaLink bindings** (MongoDB) — Discord ID/username, BlaBlaLink user ID, timestamps
• **In-memory message cache** (volatile) — last 100 messages per channel, lost on restart
section2:
**What we do NOT collect**
• Message content is not stored off-platform
• Member data is not stored off-platform
• Voice data is not recorded or stored
• User messages are not used to train AI models
section3:
**How we use your data**
AI settings → Per-server feature configuration
BlaBlaLink bindings → Discord-to-BlaBlaLink account linking
Message cache → AI chat conversation context
section4:
**Storage & Security**
MongoDB database (optional — no `MONGODB_URI` = no persistence)
Data is not sold, shared, or transmitted for marketing or analytics.
section5:
**Retention**
Configuration data (AI settings, BlaBlaLink bindings) is stored indefinitely.
There is no automatic deletion mechanism.
section6:
**Your Rights**
• Server admins: disable AI, enable mention-only mode, ban users via `/ai`
• Individual users: avoid BlaBlaLink by not using `/blabla-link`
• Individual users: avoid the AI by not using the `Enikk` prefix or replying
• Request deletion: join our support server
section7:
**Third-party Services**
The bot communicates with NKAS, nikke.gg, BlaBlaLink, and HuggingFace.
Each has its own privacy policy.
section8:
**Changes to This Policy**
The "Last updated" date is revised on changes.
Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
